summary: Carded from Fabio's ask: one supplied image in, a character sheet out, with the front full body HEADLESS. Not new on the board but never a card - it was candidate workflow 4 in MPI-348 s8, whose own working mode says surfaced ideas get their own card. Carries the Higgsfield HELL GRIND sheet spec (3 panels, headless front body, large 3/4 portrait, boring flat grey with no grain baked in, mandatory pupil catch-light, pick believable over beautiful) and flags that it CONFLICTS with Fabio's own best-performing layout from past tests (side + front profile + full body) - settle at the bench. Names the real risk: their sheets came from a PROMPT in a hosted creative model, ours must hold identity onto a back view from one photo, and MPI-348 s7 already records Qwen-Edit as weak on single-image instruction edits. Headless panel specced as a SAM3 mask + empty-prompt klein inpaint, not a prompt, which also honours their never-run-an-image-through-a-model-twice rule. Id claimed with exclusive mkdir.
